name: Chicken CS 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Chicken CS is a wild first-person shooter where you step into the feathers of a fearless chicken and dive into action-packed, hilarious battles! From teaming up in fast-paced competitions to climbing the ranks and becoming the ultimate chicken champion, this game takes classic FPS gameplay and gives it a quirky, feathery twist.
